subject: general
question:
The diagram of the human excretory system is given below. Select the option that correctly shows the functions of parts 'a' and 'b'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d58222e7803a5cc116befc47a7046a4a2562ce600a97e52ca0f85553b12d0938.png]

options.text: a - Formation of urine, b - Collection of urine
a - Formation of urine, b - Carrying urine for storage
a - Formation of urine, b - Throwing urine outside the body
a - Collection of urine, b - Formation of urine

solution:
The correct answer is __**a - Formation of urine, b - Carrying urine for storage**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Part 'a'** of the human excretory system is responsible for the **formation of urine**.
 
• **Part 'b'** of the human excretory system is responsible for **carrying urine for storage**.
 
• The correct association of functions with parts 'a' and 'b' is crucial for understanding how the excretory system works.
 
• The kidneys (part 'a') **filter blood to form urine**, while the ureters (part 'b')** transport the urine to the bladder for storage**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The human **excretory system **comprises **kidneys, ureters, bladder, and urethra**.
 
• The **kidneys** filter waste products from the blood to produce urine.
 
• The **ureters** are tubes that carry urine from the kidneys to the bladder.
 
• The **bladder** stores urine until it is excreted from the body through the **urethra**.
 
• Proper functioning of each part is essential for maintaining the body's internal environment and preventing the buildup of harmful substances.
